# exo_ome_configuration (Resource)

Manages the OMEConfiguration object via New-OMEConfiguration / Get-OMEConfiguration / Set-OMEConfiguration / Remove-OMEConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `background_color` (String) Maps to the -BackgroundColor parameter.
- `disclaimer_text` (String) Maps to the -DisclaimerText parameter.
- `email_text` (String) Maps to the -EmailText parameter.
- `external_mail_expiry_in_days` (String) Maps to the -ExternalMailExpiryInDays parameter.
- `image` (Set of String) Maps to the -Image parameter.
- `introduction_text` (String) Maps to the -IntroductionText parameter.
- `otp_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -OTPEnabled parameter.
- `portal_text` (String) Maps to the -PortalText parameter.
- `privacy_statement_url` (String) Maps to the -PrivacyStatementUrl parameter.
- `read_button_text` (String) Maps to the -ReadButtonText parameter.
- `social_id_sign_in` (Boolean) Maps to the -SocialIdSignIn parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
